name: HAPPY
description: Adds HAPPY, a browser player for your Jellyfin audio and video that drives Intiface/Buttplug toys and the DG-Lab Coyote from .funscript files next to your media. Open it from HAPPY in Jellyfin's menu or at /Happy/Web/ on your server. The plugin indexes the funscripts, serves them through Jellyfin's own authentication and lets admins set the player defaults on its settings page.
overview: Haptic player for Jellyfin: sync toys to funscripts while you watch or listen
